# EvolveUI

`ETheme.qml`, `ECard.qml`, `EButton.qml` and `EDropdown.qml` are adapted from EvolveUI under the MIT license. The launcher supplies its theme explicitly, uses a text glyph for the dropdown arrow and adds keyboard and accessibility handling. The components are bundled as Qt resources.

Upstream revision [11f904cf39df3d7c41328fd72b8c0d8042a8c79c](https://github.com/sudoevolve/EvolveUI/tree/11f904cf39df3d7c41328fd72b8c0d8042a8c79c).
